alerts.title: Flood Advisory
alerts.detail: Flood Advisory issued November 27 at 4:23AM EST until November 27 at 1:15PM EST by NWS Upton NY
alerts.body:
* WHAT...Minor tidal flooding is possible around the times of high
tide this morning.

* WHERE...The Hudson River in Westchester, Rockland, Orange, and
Putnam counties in southeastern New York.

* WHEN...Until 115 PM EST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Minor tidal flooding is possible along the river around
the times of high tide.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 422 AM EST, Water levels along the Hudson River could rise to
minor thresholds during the times of high tide this morning.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

* INSTRUCTIONS...Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.
